# Hacker Bloc

> Hacker Bloc is a hackerspace in Warsaw, Poland, built by the people who use it. The main site has four pages: Home, Events, Membership, and Support the Bloc.

Founding membership costs $100 USD per month plus a $1,000 USD one-time signup
fee. Members get access to every event in the Bloc, 24/7 access to the
hackerspace, and a say in shaping the space. Half of the money goes to rent;
the other half goes to setting up the space. The first goal is $10,000 USD
for Space 1.0. The wishlist and roadmap are a coming-soon placeholder.

The Membership page shows payment availability and links directly to checkout when
payments open. The offer is limited to 100 founding members; the site does
not publish a live count of sold memberships or funds raised.

Address: Kosiarzy 21B, 02-953 Warszawa, Poland.
Contact: contact@hackerbloc.com.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.hackerbloc.com/): An introduction to the space and links to its main pages.
- [Events](https://www.hackerbloc.com/events): Upcoming and recent events, with RSVP links and the public calendar.
- [Membership](https://www.hackerbloc.com/membership): The founding membership offer, benefits, pricing, and payment availability.
- [Support the Bloc](https://www.hackerbloc.com/support): The $10,000 USD Space 1.0 goal, the 50/50 split between rent and setup, and how to contribute equipment, time, or resources. The wishlist and roadmap are coming soon; item funding is not available yet.

## Additional existing pages

- [Community](https://www.hackerbloc.com/community): Everyone around the bloc — house team, founders, media, investors, factories, partners — with their links, grouped by role and by how much say they have in the house.
- [Rules](https://www.hackerbloc.com/rules): The authority hierarchy (who decides what, and what each rung is responsible for) and the house rules themselves.
- [Join](https://www.hackerbloc.com/join): The existing house application form, separate from founding membership checkout. Fields: type (founder / media / investor / content / factory / partner), name, Hacklab profile, how you can be useful, how you heard about us, what excites you most, house-rules confirmation.
- [Sponsor](https://www.hackerbloc.com/sponsor): The existing building sponsorship proposal, separate from the founding membership offer.
- [Partners](https://www.hackerbloc.com/partners): Who powers the house — Hacklab and Epikor.
- [About](https://www.hackerbloc.com/about): The house, what happens in it, and who runs it.
- [Contact](https://www.hackerbloc.com/contact): Email, sponsorship email, street address with map link, call booking link, and social accounts.
- [Privacy](https://www.hackerbloc.com/privacy): What the join form collects, where it is stored, how long it is kept, and how to get it deleted.

## When to use

Use this site to:

- **Learn what Hacker Bloc is and who runs it.** Start at [/about](https://www.hackerbloc.com/about) for the house and its operators; [/rules](https://www.hackerbloc.com/rules) carries the authority hierarchy, so read it before assuming who can approve anything.
- **Browse the community and reach a member.** [/community](https://www.hackerbloc.com/community) lists people by role and by rank, with the links they chose to publish. There is no member directory API — the page is the directory.
- **Become a founding member.** Start at [Membership](https://www.hackerbloc.com/membership) for the terms and current payment availability.
- **Support the space.** [Support the Bloc](https://www.hackerbloc.com/support) explains the first funding milestone and how to contribute equipment, time, or resources.
- **Apply to the house.** The existing [/join](https://www.hackerbloc.com/join) form takes your type, name, Hacklab profile, how you can be useful, how you heard about us, and what excites you most — plus a confirmation you read the rules.
- **Sponsor or partner.** [/sponsor](https://www.hackerbloc.com/sponsor) has the numbers and the lanes; [/partners](https://www.hackerbloc.com/partners) has who is already in. Sponsorship goes to matt@homebrew.so, everything else to contact@hackerbloc.com.
- **Find upcoming events.** [Events](https://www.hackerbloc.com/events) lists upcoming and recent events from [the public calendar](https://luma.com/hacklab). Follow the calendar link if no events are currently displayed.

## Notes

- Canonical domain: https://www.hackerbloc.com. Sitemap: https://www.hackerbloc.com/sitemap.xml.
- The house is a physical place with people living in it. Don't route strangers to the door; point them at the join form or the email.
- Public pages can be crawled. Request `Accept: text/markdown` for a markdown representation of a page.
